About Us
Selector is building an AI-driven network observability platform. By adopting an AI/ML-based analytics approach, the platform provides actionable multi-dimensional insights to network, cloud, and application operators. It enables operations teams to meet their KPIs through seamless collaboration, search-driven conversational user experience, and automated data engineering pipelines.
Our solutions are used by leading Telecoms, Media Providers, Retail, and Professional Sports organizations across the world. Our novel approach and rapidly expanding footprint put us in the unique position for continued growth to become a category leader. To fuel our growth, we are seeking passionate, high-energy, results-oriented individuals to join our team.
Our mission is to deliver world-class solutions on behalf of the large enterprise. Supported by leading investors, Selector is uniquely positioned to deliver a world-class solution to address large enterprise requirements across the globe. 
Selector offers a discretionary PTO policy, health insurance, 401k, the opportunity for a bonus, and more.
Position Summary:
As a Technical Marketing Engineer (TME), you will be the bridge between our high-level product strategy and the deep technical reality of our users. You aren't just a marketer; you are a power user, a storyteller, and a technical expert. You will be responsible for creating the "proof" that our platform solves real-world problems for network engineers.
Key Responsibilities:

• Technical Content Creation: Develop high-quality technical assets including deep-dive white papers, reference architectures, technical blogs, and detailed "how-to" guides.

• Demo Excellence: Build, maintain, and script world-class demo environments. You will ensure our sales engineering team has the best "sandboxes" to showcase our ML-driven insights.

• Competitive Intelligence: Stay ahead of the AIOps landscape. Conduct hands-on lab testing of competing products to create "Why Selector" technical battlecards.

• "How-To" Series: Build and record a library of snackable technical tutorials designed to reduce time-to-value for new users.

• AI-Assisted Development: Utilize modern AI coding tools (like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Replit) to rapidly prototype custom front-end dashboards and visualization layers.

• Industry Expertise: Stay up-to-date on the latest networking technologies, industry trends (e.g., AIOps, Network Automation, SASE, SD-WAN), and competitor products.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Engineering, or a related field. MBA is a plus.

• 5+ years of engineering experience

• Modern Dev Workflow: Proficiency with Cursor or similar AI-augmented IDEs to accelerate the creation of React, Vue, or Tailwind-based front-end demos.

• Creative Suite: Familiarity with video capture and editing tools (e.g., Camtasia, Loom, Descript, or Adobe Premiere).

• Networking & Ops Core: You must speak the language of the persona—BGP, gNMI, Flow data, and OpenConfig should be second nature.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to inform decisions.

• A self-starter who can thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.

• unlimited weeks of paid time off, plus company holidays.

• A dynamic and collaborative work environment with a focus on professional growth.

• Opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology and make a significant impact on the company's success.

a530c88716e15f83.description:
QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢.

The Role

We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality.

You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to.

Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are.

The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking.

This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer.

We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it.

If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

What Work Looks Like

You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable.

Every day

• Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it.

• Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution.

• Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform.

Delighting customers

• Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success.

• Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked.

• Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates.

Making support smarter with AI

• Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off.

• Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do.

• Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving.

Keeping the product solid

• Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected.

• Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors.

• Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice.

Running the week

• Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated.

• Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps.

Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude.

Who You Are

• You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls.

• You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things.

• You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding.

• You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom.

• Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said.

• You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity.

• You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results.

• You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack.

• Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive.

• Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are.

A Plus If You Have

• Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role.

• Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps.

• Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client.

• Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report.

• An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment.

How We Work Together

You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer.

Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice:

• Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask.

• Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt.

• Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked.

• The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on.

• The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you.

This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once.

Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too.

Benefits

• Contract type: full-time or part-time

• Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099).

• Start date: negotiable

a5e690f7cd1a7e59.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,  you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

About the Role
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) at Razorpay combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems that power India’s digital payment infrastructure. SRE ensures that Razorpay’s services — both our internally critical and our externally- visible systems — have the reliability, uptime, and performance appropriate to the needs of millions of businesses and their customers. Given that every transaction on our platform represents real money movement, the stakes for reliability are exceptionally high. As an SRE, you will keep an ever-watchful eye on system capacity, performance, and latency across a stack processing $180+ billion in annualized transactions. Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure, and eliminating manual work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale that are unique to a high-throughput fintech platform, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis, and large-scale system design. You will increasingly leverage AI and machine learning to transform how we operate — from AI- assisted incident detection and response, to ML driven anomaly detection, predictive capacity planning, and intelligent alerting that reduces noise and surfaces real issues before they impact customers. SRE’s culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving, and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big, and take risks in a blame free environment.


The SRE team at Razorpay supports services that are foundational to running production at scale — including payment routing, rate limiting, shard management, traffic shaping, and the reliability of core payment, payout, and reconciliation systems. These platforms implement safety guardrails, risk controls, regulatory compliance mechanisms, accounting integrity, and dynamic load balancing for stateful services. Behind everything our customers see is the architecture built by the Infrastructure team to keep it running, and we are proud to be our engineers’ engineers.


Responsibilities
• Develop strong, influential relationships with multiple stakeholders across the Site Reliability Engineering, Developer, and Product organizations.
• Serve as an expert on particular fields of knowledge related to rate limiting, sharding, traffic management, and large-scale distributed system reliability for Razorpay’s payment platform.
• Develop plans and lead projects that evolve our production systems and their reliability — spanning capacity planning, failure-mode analysis, and architectural improvements for high- throughput, low-latency payment infrastructure.
• Design, build, and operate automation tooling and self-healing infrastructure that eliminates manual toil and improves system resilience across the payments stack.
• Leverage AI and ML to build intelligent observability — anomaly detection, predictive alerting, noise reduction, and correlation engines that surface real issues before they impact customers.
• Drive AI-assisted incident management: use LLM-based tooling for root-cause analysis, incident summarization, runbook generation, and post-incident learning to reduce mean-time-to- resolution (MTTR).
• Build and maintain reliability for AI-native and AI-assisted products — including agentic payments, AI-driven fraud detection, and real-time risk intelligence — ensuring the infrastructure supporting ML models and inference pipelines is production-grade.
